    potential = {
        exists = from
        from = {
            check_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 1 }
            NOR = {
                AND = {
                    has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_alloys
                    has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_consumer_goods
                    has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_trade
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_energy }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_minerals }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_food }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_unity }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_physics_research }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_society_research }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_engineering_research }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_rare_crystals }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_volatile_motes }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_exotic_gases }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    allow = { always = yes }
    effect = {
        hidden_effect = {
            from = {
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_energy
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_minerals
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_food
                set_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_alloys
                set_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_consumer_goods
                set_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_trade
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_unity
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_physics_research
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_society_research
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_engineering_research
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_rare_crystals
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_volatile_motes
                remove_country_flag = bca_jr_filter_exotic_gases
                country_event = { id = colony_automation_event.2001 }
            }
        }
    }
}

                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_empty_wrangler
                    set_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_wrangler
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_empty_turtle_miner_gestalt
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_turtle_miner_gestalt
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s9_job_wrangler }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_manual_wrangler
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_empty_wrangler
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_wrangler
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

    potential = {
        exists = from
        from = {
            has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s15_mapped
            check_variable = { which = bca_gui_active_tab value = 1 }
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s15_job_agri_drone
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_empty_agri_drone }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_agri_drone }

                        has_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_manual_agri_drone
                    }

                AND = {
                    has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s15_job_alien_hunter

                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_alien_hunter }
                    OR = {
                        has_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_manual_alien_hunter
                    }
                }
                AND = {
                    has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s15_job_archivist
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_empty_archivist }
                    NOT = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_archivist }
                    OR = {
                        has_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_manual_archivist
                    }

                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_empty_translucer_drone
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_translucer_drone
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s15_job_treasure_gatherer }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_manual_treasure_gatherer
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_empty_treasure_gatherer
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_treasure_gatherer
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s15_job_treasure_gatherer_gestalt }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_manual_treasure_gatherer_gestalt
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_empty_treasure_gatherer_gestalt
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_treasure_gatherer_gestalt
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s15_job_turtle_miner_gestalt }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_manual_turtle_miner_gestalt
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_empty_turtle_miner_gestalt
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_turtle_miner_gestalt
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_country_flag = bca_jr_slot_s15_job_wrangler }
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_manual_wrangler
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_empty_wrangler
                    remove_country_flag = bca_jr_mode_full_wrangler
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
